bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are allowed after inspection; nonclear bags may require extra screening. Oversized bags are refused.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue’s garage entrance is next to the hall on California Street and operates 24 hours a day; advance purchase is recommended because spaces are limited.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue lists rideshare as an arrival option but does not publish a designated pickup or drop-off position.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue has a bar and food service; outside food and drinks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue publishes a separate accessibility page covering arrival and on-site assistance; check its guidance or contact the venue for the specific concert.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is prohibited; a guest who leaves needs a new ticket to return.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets are held at the lobby box office and require a photo ID matching the purchaser. The box office opens 30 minutes before event doors and also on Saturdays from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors are normally an hour before showtime but may change. Security uses metal detectors or pat-downs and searches bags.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
